    2025/10/13

    Nanya Technology Reports Results for the Third Quarter 2025

    October 13, 2025 – Nanya Technology Corporation, (TWSE: 2408), today announced its results of operations for the third quarter, ended September 30, 2025. Nanya's quarterly sales revenue was NT$ 18,779 million, a 78.4 percent increase compared to that in the second quarter of 2025. In the third quarter of 2025, average selling prices (ASP) increased by forties percent and bit shipment increased by mid-twenties percent quarter over quarter.

    Gross profit of the quarter was NT$ 3,465 million; gross margin was 18.5 percent, a 39.1 percentage points improvement from that in the previous quarter. Operating income of the quarter was NT$ 1,119 million; operating margin was 6.0 percent; a 48.8 percentage points improvement from that in the last quarter. Non-operating income of the quarter was NT$ 904 million. The Company had net income of NT$ 1,563 million, with net margin of 8.3 percent. Earnings per share (EPS) was NT$ 0.50 in the third quarter (based on weighted average outstanding shares of 3,099 million). Book value per share was NT$ 50.78 at the quarter end. All numbers are unaudited.

    NTC's 1B 16Gb DDR5-5600 shipment has reached 10%, and DDR5-6400 also meets design specifications. The Company's 1C and 1D process are piloting on schedule. Development of TSV/DDP technology and customized HBM products is progressing on track. Additionally, DDR4 and LPDDR4 shipments will continue to increase to meet customer demand.

    ** FX impact: unfavorable NT$ 1.1B in Q2'25
